This was a '''battle''' fought on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gira]], who was protecting a group of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Gira fended off the stormtroopers, but was ambushed by Vader. After a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], Vader convinced the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to join him, promising to spare the lives of the Padawans, who were aboard an escape vessel. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] betrayed Gira, ordering the [[Unidentified starship commander|ship's commander]], who had also betrayed Gira, to activate the explosives that were placed aboard the Padawan's ship. After this, Vader left Gira, and the Jedi committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the story "[[The Duty]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Tales 12|''Star Wars Tales'' 12]] and written by [[Christian Read]]. The story was later compiled into a trade paperback version, ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 3]]''. Plausible stories in [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were initially viewed as [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> The battle was later mentioned in Gira's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', treating the battle as a unique event and raising its existence in ''The Duty'' to C-canon.

In ''The Duty'', the battle is said to have taken place in a base.<ref name="The Duty" /> However, Gira's entry in ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' states that the battle took place on a starship.<ref name="CSWE: Gira" />
